messages:
incident-bot: @here We are seeing a spike in TCP resets and websocket reconnects from sa-edge region (SA). Initial alert triggered at 2026-07-14T09:30:10Z. Incident ID INC-2026-0458. Impact: Intermittent WebSocket disconnects and increased generation tail latency for hosted/edge routing customers in SA. Investigating.

sre-lina: Observed reset rate ~5% -> 12% over 5m on sa-edge-02 and sa-edge-03. Kernel tcp_recv_err logs show RSTs tied to NIC RX buffer overruns. Sample log:
```
[sa-edge-03] tcp: RST from remote, errno -104, skb->len=0
RX queue drops stats: q_len=1024 dropped=128
```

ops-ricardo: Starting graceful drain of sa-edge-03 now. Rerouting production websocket flows via edge-router-sa-01/02. Will disable session stickiness temporarily.

eng-jamie: Looking at recent infra changes — we pushed nic-driver v1.2.7 last night to sa-edge-03. Suspect regression. Plan: rollback nic-driver on sa-edge-03 to v1.2.5 and disable kernel offload feature 'gro' while we validate.

sre-lina: Executing rollback (sa-edge-03):
```
ssh root@sa-edge-03 sudo apt-get install nic-driver=1.2.5
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_gro=0
```
Tracking health metrics during rollback.

infra-bot: Deployment rollback job #deploy-5543 started for sa-edge-03. Job link: https://build.redwood.ai/deploys/5543

cs-amelia: Notifying CS/SRE on priority contacts. Posted initial status update to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0458 and emailed top 20 customers with SA traffic. Template used: "We are investigating intermittent streaming disruptions in South America. Engineers are actively mitigating." :phone:

incident-bot: Update at +7m: sa-edge-03 rollback in progress. Metric: websocket reconnect rate down from 12% -> 4.1% so far. Some customers still seeing reconnects.

ops-ricardo: sa-edge-03 drained and marked maintenance. Traffic now balanced across sa-edge-01/02/04. No additional errors on sa-edge-01/02.

eng-jamie: Rollback completed. Confirmed driver v1.2.5 and tcp_gro=0 on sa-edge-03. Running synthetic streaming tests.

sre-lina: Synthetic tests show stable websocket sessions for 30m, reconnect rate <0.5%. Continuing monitoring for 2 hours. Setting incident state to "mitigated".

incident-bot: INC-2026-0458 status -> mitigated. RCA task created: https://go.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0458/rca

pm-oliver: Schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:00am PT in #postmortems. Please add logs and timeline to the RCA doc. Action owners: eng-jamie (driver regression), ops-ricardo (traffic-steer playbook), sre-lina (monitoring/gating)

cs-amelia: CS follow-up scheduled: customer update 3pm PT with ask to reopen ticket if they still see issues.

sre-lina: Closing thread here, we will post the postmortem link once ready. Thanks everyone. :heart:
